give_a_bia_a_place_to: Give a bia a place to live
a_bia_is_not_an_app: A bia is not an app you install on your computer. It is a whole computer of its own. So getting one means choosing where it lives: on a server we run for you, on a server you rent, or on a computer you already have. Wherever it starts, it can move later as the same someone.
bia_cloud_we_run_its_computer: bia cloud: we run its computer
give_it_a_name_and_a: Give it a name and a language, pay once, and about half an hour later your bia is awake on its own server, with a brain included. We keep the server running and backed up. Only you hold its key, we do not look inside, and you can take it home to your own computer any time.
from_17_99_a_month_for: From €17.99 a month for its computer, billed every two weeks from a balance
thinking_is_paid_as_it_is: Thinking is paid as it is used; switch to your own AI account by asking bia
nothing_to_install_you_talk_to: Nothing to install: you talk to it from your phone or browser
start_a_bia_in_the_cloud: Start a bia in the cloud
free_and_open_source_bia_deploy: Free and open source. bia deploy puts a bia on a server you rent, with no commands to type, or writes it onto a USB stick that turns any PC or laptop into one.
servers_only_the_same_app_is: Servers only. The same app is then your chat with bia.
from_github_no_play_store_needed: from GitHub, no Play Store needed
app_store_testflight_for_betas_appdb: App Store · TestFlight for betas · appdb is another install path
one_command_on_a_running_linux: <0>One command</0> on a running Linux server: <1>the server guide</1>
on_a_mac_in_a_virtual: <0>On a Mac</0>, in a virtual machine: <1>ClawHome</1>
where_it_can_live_and_what: Where it can live, and what it does there by itself
the_computer_is_bias_body_not: The computer is bia’s body, not its identity. Its name, memories, people, accounts and skills are one folder that it looks after and can carry elsewhere.
about_twenty_minutes_download_bia: About twenty minutes: download bia deploy above, choose a brain, write a USB stick, start the computer from it. bia wakes up and greets you.
the_smartest_answers_using_an_ai: The smartest answers, using an AI service with your own account. Right now the cheapest good choice is DeepSeek V4.1: you pay only for what bia uses, and it runs on any computer. The stick stays small, but bia needs the internet. Paste your key into bia deploy and it is stored only on your stick.
for_places_without_internet_a_complete: For places without internet, a complete AI model can travel on the stick instead. Needs a larger stick and a powerful computer: a high-end graphics card, or unified memory, with at least 64 GB of video memory (VRAM). You can switch between the two later.
write_the_stick_and_start_a: Write the stick and start a computer
plug_in_a_usb_stick_of: Plug in a USB stick of 8 GB or more. Everything on it will be replaced.
open_bia_deploy_and_choose_the: Open bia deploy and choose the brain: sign in with ChatGPT or paste a key, and press Wake bia up. bia says hello when the brain works.
choose_on_a_usb_stick_pick: Choose “On a USB stick”, pick the stick and the kind of computer it is for, and press Write. The first time, it downloads the bia system for that kind of computer (about 1 GB) and keeps it for the next stick.
plug_the_stick_into_the_computer: Plug the stick into the computer that will become bia and switch it on. If it starts its old system instead, open the computer’s start-up menu (often F12, F11, Esc or Option ⌥) and choose the USB stick.
bia_wakes_up_and_greets_you: bia wakes up and greets you. Say hello!
one_stick_one_kind_of_computer: <0>One stick, one kind of computer.</0> Ordinary PCs and ARM computers need different systems, so bia deploy asks which kind the stick is for. Have both? Make one stick for each.
ordinary_pc_almost_any_intel_or: <0>Ordinary PC:</0> almost any Intel or AMD desktop or laptop, such as a ten-year-old office PC, a gaming PC or a Windows laptop. It starts with Secure Boot switched on, and older machines without the modern start-up (UEFI) start it the classic way (BIOS).
arm_computer_arm_mini_pcs_and: <0>ARM computer:</0> ARM mini-PCs and boards whose start-up menu works the standard (UEFI) way. Whether Secure Boot can stay on depends on the machine: if the stick does not start, switch Secure Boot off in its settings.
not_supported_macs_with_apple_chips: <0>Not supported:</0> Macs with Apple chips (M1 and newer) cannot start from a bia stick. They can still run bia deploy.
bia_already_lives_on_another_kind: <0>bia already lives on another kind of computer?</0> Its mind can move across. For example, bia runs on an old Intel laptop and you bought an ARM mini-PC: make an ARM stick, start the mini-PC from it and tell the new bia to wait for the old one. Then ask the old bia to move over. Both screens show the same code, and once you confirm, its chats, memories, accounts and passwords arrive on the mini-PC. Keep the mini-PC online during the move, so bia can reinstall its extra programs in their ARM versions. <1>How moving works</1>
a_server_instead_of_a_stick: <0>A server instead of a stick?</0> Choose “On my server” after the brain. bia deploy logs in to the server with its password or key, checks it, and replaces its system with bia. <1>More about servers</1>
tell_it_its_name_give_it: Tell it its name, give it a phone number of its own, and add it to the family chat.
a_server_we_keep_running_and: A server we keep running and backed up. Awake in about half an hour.
any_linux_server_or_vps_bia: Any Linux server or VPS. bia deploy replaces its system with bia.
almost_any_intel_or_amd_machine: Almost any Intel or AMD machine of the last ten or more years, or an ARM mini-PC.
bia_can_stay_on_the_stick: bia can stay on the stick and wake up on whatever computer it is plugged into.
on_a_mac_with_clawhome_or: On a Mac with ClawHome, or in any hypervisor from the install image.
bia_folds_itself_into_one_archive: bia folds itself into one archive — memories, chats, accounts, passwords, browser, skills — and unfolds on another machine as the same someone: from a stick onto a disk, from a laptop to a server, from Intel to ARM, from bia cloud to your home. It can fly across the network by itself.
it_installs_its_own_system_updates: It installs its own system updates, then checks what the update broke and fixes it before telling you. Its files are checked at every start, its settings keep a last good copy, and it makes its own backups.
bia_has_a_clock_and_a: bia has a clock and a calendar. It keeps schedules, watches inboxes and pages, writes to people first when something is due, and stays quiet when there is nothing to say. After being switched off it catches up on everything it missed.
when_a_tool_is_missing_bia: When a tool is missing, bia writes it: a new skill, a connection to a service, a watcher for something you care about. Each one lives in its own folder with a description, survives updates and can be handed to another bia.
give_a_bia_the_login_of: Give a bia the login of a rented server and it will wake a new bia there by itself — for the shop, for the grandparents — or prepare a place and fly there. Bias recognise each other by certificate and talk on their own link.
its_brain_is_an_ai_model: Its brain is an AI model you pick and can change by asking: a ChatGPT plan, an inexpensive pay-as-you-go model, or a model running on its own powerful computer without the internet. If the brain fails, it falls back to the previous one and tells you.
passwords_one_time_codes_and_passkeys: Passwords, one-time codes and passkeys for bia’s own accounts are in a safe on its machine. You reach bia with a personal certificate; nobody else gets in, including us.
bia_never_asks_for_the_keys: bia never asks for the keys to your computer or your accounts. It has its own number, email and logins, and you share with it what you would share with a colleague.
get_bia_in_the_cloud_on: Get bia — in the cloud, on your server or an old computer
where_a_bia_can_live_and: Where a bia can live and how to get one: bia cloud runs it for you; the bia deploy app puts it on your own server or a USB stick.
